title: Default credentials on admin panel
notes:
The admin panel at /admin accepts the vendor default credentials.
Login worked with username admin and password=admin123
After login I can change prices, view all orders and export the customer list.
The credentials were never changed since installation.

evidence.name: admin-login.txt
evidence.text:
POST /admin/login HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.acme.test

username=admin&password=admin123

HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: /admin/orders
